subject: Wire delegation out-of-projects_root approval gating
description:
In `capo/tools/claude_code.py` (and later `codex.py`), check `brief.repo_path` against `paths.projects_root`. If outside, spawn the approval workflow with `action_kind='delegate_out_of_tree'` and `action_payload={'agent': ..., 'repo_path': ..., 'goal': ...}`. On approve, proceed with the spawn; on deny/expire, return tool error.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] `repo_path` resolution uses canonical path (resolves symlinks, expanduser) before comparison.
- [ ] In-tree paths bypass approval entirely.
- [ ] Out-of-tree paths trigger approval; question text includes agent kind, goal, and full resolved path.
- [ ] On approve: spawn proceeds normally.
- [ ] On deny/expire: tool returns clear error; no row inserted.

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] `repo_path` is a symlink pointing inside `projects_root`: treated as in-tree (after resolution).
- [ ] `projects_root` is a symlink: resolved before comparison.

**Testing Requirements:**
• Integration: in-tree delegation no approval needed
• Integration: out-of-tree delegation triggers approval; approve → spawn proceeds; deny → no row inserted

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Sections 5.3, 5.8, 9.4
